messages.en:
{07 0a 00}There's nothing quite like
deafening airborne
explosions, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0a 00}Pole midagi paremat kui
kõrvulukustav plahvatus
õhus, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I've been looking forward
all day{01 00 00 0f 00} to watchin' the
fireworks tonight!
{07 05 00}C'mon, people! Let's get
the show on the road,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma olen terve päeva
oodanud{01 00 00 0f 00} täna õhtust
ilutulestikku!
{07 05 00}Ole nüüd, rahvas! Paneme
show käima,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}ARGGGH! {01 00 00 05 00}I just can't wait
anymore, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 01 00}What do we want?! FIREWORKS!
When do we want 'em?! NOW!!!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}ARGGGH! {01 00 00 05 00}Ma ei jaksa enam
oodata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 01 00}Mida tahame?! TULEVÄRKI!
Millal tahame?! NÜÜD!!!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Man,{01 00 00 05 00} that's really somethin',
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}They look the same no
matter which angle you see
'em from.
{07 0b 00}How'd they do that,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Poiss,{01 00 00 05 00} see on alles midagi,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 00 00}Nad näevad ühesugused
välja, ükskõik mis nurga
alt sa neid vaatad.
{07 0b 00}Kuidas nad seda tegid,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Tonight's fireworks are
almost over, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 05 00}HEY!{01 00 00 0f 00} That last one better
boom REAL LOUD!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tänaõhtune ilutulestik on
peaaegu läbi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 05 00}HEI!{01 00 00 0f 00} See viimane parem
mürtsugu VÄGA VALJULT!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Ohhhh YESSSSSSSSSSSS!{01 00 00 0f 00}
The {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks Show{ff 00 00 00} has
started, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}I've wanted to be a
pyrotechnician since I was
just a little spud.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ohhhh JAAAAAAAA!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{ff 00 00 03}Ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00} on
alanud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Ma olen tahtnud olla
pürotehnik juba sellest
ajast, kui olin põnn.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}! The
fireworks are finally going
to start, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 05 00}Whooooeeee!{01 00 00 0f 00} Make 'em go
BOOOM!{01 00 00 0f 00} BOOOOOOOOOOM!!!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}! Ilutulestik
hakkab lõpuks pihta,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 05 00}Huuuiii!{01 00 00 0f 00} Pange need
PAUKUMA!{01 00 00 0f 00} PAUUUUUUUUK!!!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}The fireworks are bigger
and badder than usual this
year, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Awesome{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00} I love it!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ilutulestik on sel aastal
suurem ja hullem kui
tavaliselt, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Vinge{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00} Mulle meeldib!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Last year's fireworks were
no slouch, but they look
FIERCE tonight!{01 00 00 14 00}
Definitely more...manly
somehow, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Eelmise aasta ilutulestik
polnud paha, aga täna
õhtul näevad need MÕHKAD!{01 00 00 14 00}
Kindlasti kuidagi...
mehelikumad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}What's yer problem, {01 00 00 05 00}kid?!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Get into the mood!

{07 16 00}What, did ya accidentally
eat your pet coconut or
somethin', {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Mis sul viga on, {01 00 00 05 00}laps?!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Mine tujusse!

{07 16 00}Mis, kas sa sõid kogemata
oma lemmikkookospähkli ära
või midagi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Why can't they blow up
fireworks on the ground?
That would be so cool.
Y'know, stuff blowin' up and
all that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Miks nad ei lase
ilutulestikku maa peal
õhku? See oleks nii lahe.
Tead küll, asjad lendavad
õhku ja nii, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 05 00}Whoaaa!{01 00 00 14 00} These fireworks are
gettin' me all worked up,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}I know it's crazy, but I
wanna break-dance to the
fireworks or somethin'!
messages.et:
{07 05 00}Ohhoooo!{01 00 00 14 00} See ilutulestik
ajab mu täitsa hoogu,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Tean, et see on hull, aga
ma tahan ilutulestiku saatel
breiki tantsida!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Well, tonight's the last
night to see fireworks for
the year, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}{07 10 00}I'm really gonna miss seeing
stuff explodinating up in
the sky at night.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Noh, täna on selle aasta
viimane õhtu ilutulestikku
vaadata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}{07 10 00}Mul hakkab tõesti puudu
jääma asjadest, mis öösel
taevas plahvatavad.
